title: Turn a full exterior residual into an arbitrary-reference code-channel bound
statement: For a piecewise absolutely continuous trial map V(t), bound the exact code-isometry error by initial error plus integral sqrt(lambda_max(R*R)) and jump norms, R=dot V+i H V. If the trial is isometric, this bounds half-diamond error; if its error is epsilon<1, polar repair gives at most2epsilon.
